description: This file is a shell script containing test setups and test cases for Git commands, specifically testing the '--set-upstream' option for 'git fetch' and 'git pull'. It includes functions to prepare configs, perform Git operations, and verify outcomes, and it defines various test scenarios for branch configurations.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Checks if a branch's remote and merge configurations match expected values.

methods.name: check_config_missing
methods.description: Verifies that the remote and merge configurations for a branch are missing.

methods.name: clear_config
methods.description: Clears branch-specific remote and merge configurations.

methods.name: ensure_fresh_upstream
methods.description: Initializes a fresh bare Git repository for testing upstream fetch and pull.
